sections.heading: Transcription
sections.text: RB [Nummer] [Zugname] [Ort] - [Ort] Hbf 05:54 [Ort] Abfahrt 5:52 Weiterfahrt nach 5:54 [Ort] (Halt bei Bedarf) 6:00 [Ort] Hbf Standort im Zug

sections.heading: Meaning
sections.text: The display inside a regional train (RB, Regionalbahn). It shows the line, the route and the clock (05:54). The train is at a station and left at 5:52 ( Abfahrt ). It goes on ( Weiterfahrt ) to the next stop at 5:54, where it only stops on request ( Halt bei Bedarf ), and arrives at the main station ( Hbf , Hauptbahnhof ) at 6:00. Standort im Zug shows where you are in the train.
